notes: Research ledger for high-volume named-site sources. Materialized registry identity is distinct from legal label-claim authority.

bourgogne_maps_bulk.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne (BIVB) / Bourgogne Maps
bourgogne_maps_bulk.coverage_note: BIVB reports 11,541 identified Climats and lieux-dits and 296,663 mapped parcels. The current materialized corpus remains a reviewed subset; lack of a materialized row is not negative evidence that a Bourgogne lieu-dit does not exist.

rlp_weinbergsrolle.coverage_note: The live source covers more than 1,600 Einzellagen and registered Gewannen. The materialized data are the official Ernte 2024 register: 1,533 unique six-digit Lagennummer identities. It is historical registry evidence, not a silently current 2026 legal snapshot.

noe_rieden_open_data.authority: Land Niederösterreich, Abteilung BD1 - GIS Support
noe_rieden_open_data.coverage_note: The official OGD WFS yielded 3,342 features and 3,386 distinct Ried/Subried identities. The publisher states that statewide capture is incomplete, so absence from this snapshot is not negative evidence.

vienna_rieden.coverage_note: The official Vienna Riedenkarte and 2016 city regulation contain all 140 Weinbaurieden with parcel-level delimitations. The materialized registry preserves the 140 consolidated vineyard identities.
